notes.title: 20th Minor Update
notes.content:
Hi guys, today's update is quite small but I am sure some of you will really really appreciate it.

Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] Added blueprint sorting (you can move blueprints up and down in the buildings menu)
[*] Added scientific notation (in the UI tab of the settings menu)
[*] Improved UI text in the game to not be pixelated in big resolutions
[*] Changed Russian and Korean fonts (to fix some pixelation issues)
[/list]

Let me know what you think of the update, and if there are other QoL features you would like to see in the game.
That's all for now, enjoy!

[list]

[*] Achievements localization
[*] Removed 1M clicks and 100 ascensions achievements
[*] Improved volume controls
[*] Completed/Unlocked chests will no longer apply load
[*] Skins preview in the skin menu are now scaled so they do not hide any elements
[*] Lubing gear skins now behave as intended
[*] Blueprints with a "/" character in their name are no longer possible as that would cause some issues
[*] Leaderboards will now load faster
[*] Leaderboards will now use the default font if possible
[/list]

That is everything for now, enjoy!

notes.title: 1.2 Content Update
notes.content:
It's been 6 month since the last update, I've been hard at work, listening to all your feedback, and addressing most of it in this big content update.

This update includes a lot of new things, here is a list:
[list]
[*] 4 new gears!
[*] 3 new buildings!
[*] 4 new areas!
[*] New ascension upgrades!
[*] A new currency
[*] A blueprints system
[*] Skins!!!!
[*] Workshop integration to share both blueprints and skins 😜
[*] MORE ACHIEVEMENTS
[*] A reworked buildings menu
[*] A reworked shortcut menu (triggered by pressing 1, 2, 3 or 4)
[*] The ascension gear now shows you how much torque will be added to the system
[/list]

I lost track of all the new and small features added, so there might be some more little things 😅

There have been lots of quality of life upgrades aswell as bug fixes, if you previously reported a bug, it will probably be fixed, if not please let me know and I will fix it ASAP

The game has now Trading Cards, emojis, profile backgrounds and some animated stickers!

That should be all, I hope you like it and have fun!

To celebrate, Idling Gears will be on a 25% sale for the next week, and then on a 20% disocunt during the Steam Summer Sales!

If you find any bug, please let me know here so I can fix it!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2285820/discussions/0/3819662889082114202/

notes.title: 11th Minor Update
notes.content:
Minor update

Changes:
[list]
[*] Corrected some misspellings

Thanks Scullsglory for reporting most of the issues and making great suggestions!

notes.title: Idling Gears 1.1
notes.content:
Hello there, this is the first non-minor update. Reworked some things added others and fixed a lot.
Here are the changes:

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved settings menu with sections and a ton of options (would love to hear if you have any option you want me to add to the game)
[*] Enriched gear stats
[*] Enriched gears build menu description
[*] Replaced ascension upgrade "suicide" with "stonks" (was really out of place)
[*] Reworked the angle system when placing new gears, instead of holding shift, control or alt you can change the angle by pressing control or shift just once
[*] You can now keep building by pressing "X" while placing a new gear
[*] Improved leaderboard font (More characters are now visible)
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with mps computation (your money per second will almost certainly be different, probably higher)
[*] Fixed visual issue with lubing gears being placed on a momma gear
[*] Fixed upgrades money prediction being misleading
[*] Fixed gears build menu description
[*] Frames per second no longer affect your production
[*] Fixed several issues with the red buff
[*] Fixed an issue with the main gear collision
[/list]

Might be missing a few things in the lists...

What's next?
With most of the minor issues of the game being fixed. I am now happy to announce that I will be working on a content update, which is really needed.

The content update will include new gears, new mechanics, new areas, new currencies and some other things...

I do not have an estimated date for this update to release, Will hopefully be ready in less than 3 months, aiming at the end of February BUT no promises.

Finally, I wanted to thank you all for playing the game and contributing to its future with great ideas and suggestions!

That is all for now, hope you enjoy this update and the good news!

notes.title: 10th Minor Update
notes.content:
Minor update, here are the changes/corrections and additions:

[list]
[*] Fixed miscalculation with cash gear rotation
[*] Fixed switch gears deactivating gears but not their income
[*] Added a new setting to hide ui when placing gears (deactivated by default)
[*] Gear stats window will now be always visible on screen and not go away when zooming out
[*] Fixed settings menu close button misbehaviour with other windows opened
[/list]

That is all for now, expect more QoL and bug fixes patch next week!

notes.title: The AFK Update (9th Minor Update)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update adds afk progress for ascension points and chests.

[b]Chests[/b]
Chests will have no limit and can be 100% opened while away, so once you return you can just claim its reward.

[b]Ascension Points[/b]
For the ascension points this limit is tight with the ascension upgreades regarding afk time.

[b]Welcome Back Screen[/b]
Also everytime you come back to the game a new screen will have a summary of what you've earned while away.

[b]Other changes and additions[/b]
This update also adds:
[list]
[*] New advanced setting option to remove zoom on chain delete
[*] New advanced setting to change autosave frequency
[*] Minigame gears will not activate/work if they are disabled by a switch
[/list]

Smaller bug fixes. That's all for now, hope you like this update!

notes.title: 8th Minor Update
notes.content:
This update should fix the game not appearing on the taskbar after launching and switching to another window/app.
Manufacturers will now not apply load once they are done crafting momma gears + some visual improvements to them.

Quick small update.

Next update will rework afk progress of the game...
The idea I have right now for this future update is that chests will still countdown when the game is closed, and you will also get 5% of your money and ascension production by default, which will be upgradeable with ascension points. These afk upgrades will also affect your ascension points. Hope this sounds good, open to suggestions, let me know what you think in the comments of this update!

notes.title: 7th Minor Update

After some beta testing, update 7 is back, here is the change list:

[list]
[*] Added stats window
[*] Added optimization/advanced settings menu (numbers for minigames now need to be activated in this menu)
[*] Fixed chest connection hitbox

That is all for now, I hope you like it!

notes.title: Sixth Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, first of all thanks to DangersoulyFunny and ImCade for covering the game in their chanells, and welcome to everyone who has discovered the game thanks to them!

This updates fixes a few things and changes some others, here the complete list:

[list]
[*] Chests and minigames reward uses money generated from structures (chests and minigames will now give more money being more viable options for late game)
[*] Fixed minigame and switch gears not being clickable after a lubing gear passes over, making them unreliable
[*] Improved settings credits and tutorial menu
[*] Changed mouse crolling behaviour when menus are open, making it way more intuitive, you can now have the gears or the upgrades menu open and still zoom in or out without pressing ctrl if the mouse is not over any menu
[*] Minigames will now also display a number over the color to make the minigames accessible to everyone(this will be an option toggeable on the menu for now it is set as ON by default)
[/list]

That is all for now, the idea is to have another update this week, with more QoL and bug fixes.

Thank you guys for everything see you later.

notes.title: Fourth Minor Update
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added chain delete, you can now delete a row of gears
[*] Added tooltip info over all structures
[*] Changed AP/s to adapt in minutes and hours
[*] Fixed chest reward being too low in some cases
[*] Improved Chest sawn areas (should no longer spawn on the bottom of the map and not be able to connect to them)

[/list]

Next patch:
[list]

[*] More QoL improvements
[*] More bug fixes
[/list]

That is all for now.

Next patch will probably come out this week!

notes.title: Third Minor Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Structures will no longer turn for a couple frames before stucking the network if the torque required is higher than the torque generated.
[*] Chests can now be deleted by holding right click
[*] Chest spawns are now limited to 15
[*] Chest will now show "??" instead of a computed "ideal" time
[*] Music will now play at the same speed after restarting the game
[*] Lubbing gears are way easier to delete at high speeds
[*] Fixed manufacturer hokey icon iterate over all numbers
[/list]

That is all for now.

Next patch will focus on QoL improvements.

Thanks for all the feedback and Ideas, I really appreciate it!

notes.title: Second Minor Update
notes.content:
As was needed, I have reworked the tutorial for the game. Hopefully this way the mechanics of it will be learned much easier. Let me know what do you think about it!

Corrected a bug with manufacturers that would make them ignore speed reductions on the connected gear.

notes.title: First Minor Update
notes.content:
Added hotkeys (from 1 to 0) for all the gears.
Lubing gears notification is now red and much more visible, so you can instantly get to where the stucked gear is

Bug fixes:
Structures will no longer turn by clicking the golden gear if your network is at 0 production due to the load being too high
Manufacturers will now update the network load when placed
Fixed a crash when ascending and the game language was set to Japanese
Fixed chests spawning on top of the ascension gear
Fixed chests spawning over gears and automatically connecting to them

Next steps, fix more bugs and improve the tutorial/learning of the game.
